comments.author: @AA_cowgomoo
comments.text:
"Bon Voyage crazy 10 babies"
If you visit DaeGu, you must must must eat MakChang. Yes it's innard, but way it's cooked and served, you'll think it's fancy sausage.  Way it's cut looks like sausage cooked on a charcoal table grill.  
I still dream of DaeGu MakChang.  
There's a saying how you can find everything in LA's K town...No. Those people never tasted DaeGu MakChang. 
I went to other cities in Korean and tried their MakChang.  Not even close.  Even Koreans in Korea don't know what they're missing unless they tried it in DaeGu.

JeonJu there are MakGeolLi GolMok (alleys) where you order Korean traditional rice drink and they'll bring out AnJu ("tapas" - food to pair with drinks)...except they're not small bites.
...Great place for a meet up since you'll be ordering kettles of MakGeolLi, you'll get to try table full of vast array of Korean AnJu that never stops coming as long as you're drinking.

Also in traditional village in JeonJu, you must try milk flavor soft serve (Yes milk, not vanilla) and 10won coin cheese bread.

BTW Didn't realize that your Dad is Korean so I did a Google image search.  Wow you look just like your dad.
